steps.en: The newest owner or driver becomes the current offender
steps.id: Owner atau driver terbaru menjadi offender saat ini
steps.why_en: The code picks whoever was written last; it does not compare update dates.
steps.why_id: Code memilih pihak yang ditulis terakhir, tidak membandingkan tanggal update.

steps.en: Follow-up goes only to the current offender
steps.id: Tindak lanjut hanya ke offender saat ini

steps.en: The current offender's ID is used for follow-up
steps.id: ID offender saat ini dipakai untuk tindak lanjut

steps.en: Other follow-ups also use the current offender
steps.id: Tindak lanjut lain juga memakai offender saat ini
steps.why_en: Admin fee and court case were not traced; one path once ignored the offender marker.
steps.why_id: Admin fee dan court case belum ditelusuri; satu jalur pernah mengabaikan penanda offender.
